facts: Product page identifies a women's 100% linen relaxed-fit blouse.
The item lists a shirt collar, half sleeves, front opening, front pocket and curved hem.
Care instructions say machine wash cold, dark colours separately, no bleach, remove promptly and dry in shade.
Cottonworld's voice is calm, warm, plain and reassuring.
Brand guidance says life comes first and clothing enters as quiet, practical support.
The brand's taxonomy includes women's tops, shirts, pants, work, travel, brunch, summer and natural-fabric categories.
